rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a substance used to provide energy, including types more specific than ordinary vehicle fuel.

example.english: This generator uses diesel as fuel.
example.traditional: 呢部發電機要用柴油做燃料。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 faat3 din6 gei1 jiu3 jung6 caai4 jau4 zou6 jin4 liu6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice for liquid fuel in vehicles and other engines, especially when the context makes the type clear.

example.english: The car has run out of fuel and can't move.
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 mou5 jau4 laa3 haang4 m4 juk1

rows.note: Use this for something that motivates, sustains, or drives an action rather than for a physical energy source.

example.english: Your support is the fuel that keeps me going.
example.traditional: 你嘅支持係我繼續做落去嘅動力。
example.jyutping: nei5 ge3 zi1 ci4 hai6 ngo5 gai3 zuk6 zou6 lok6 heoi3 ge3 dung6 lik6
